name: Testimonial Wall
hint: Hover to stop a column, drag or flick it, click a card to pull it into the spotlight, then filter by role.
description: A landing-page section of customer voices as a wall of drifting columns. Each column loops at its own pace, opposite to its neighbour, behind a window with faded edges. The pointer slows the wall and stops the column under it, the hovered card lifts while the others step back, and columns can be dragged, flicked or scrubbed with the wheel without trapping page scroll. A card opens into a centred spotlight with the full quote, its metric and next and previous, then returns to its place in the column. Filter chips re-deal the columns with FLIP. Phones get a snap rail with a peek and a bottom sheet; reduced motion gets a static masonry list with a fold. An optional heading block carries an eyebrow, a lede and an average-rating score, and it sizes itself by its container. Shows only the quotes you pass; the invented sample voices appear only with `demo`.
intents: customer quotes section for a landing page
wall of love with reviews and star ratings
social proof marquee that pauses on hover
usage: Use once on a marketing page, below the product story and above pricing, with 12 to 24 real quotes of mixed length. Pass `voices` as { id, name, quote, role?, venue?, city?, group?, source?, rating?, avatar?, more?, metric?: { value, unit, dir, label }, video?: { title, duration, poster } } and keep the pause control visible. `groups` ({ id, label, noun }) adds filter chips (voices match on `group`); `sources` maps a voice's `source` key to { label, icon }. Opening a card calls `onOpen(voice)`; the spotlight is `openId` + `onOpenIdChange` (or `defaultOpenId`), the filter `filter` + `onFilterChange`, the drift's pause `paused` + `onPausedChange`. Pass `heading`, `eyebrow`, `lede` and `score` ({ value, label, text }) for the heading block. The columns slow and stop under the pointer and hold while a card has focus; reduced motion gets the static list. Give it the full content width; it picks four, three or two columns, or a snap rail on phones, from its own width. `demo` shows the invented sample (gallery only).

example:
<TestimonialWall
  heading="What customers say"
  voices={reviews.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, name: r.author, role: r.title, venue: r.company, quote: r.text, rating: r.stars, avatar: r.photoUrl, group: r.segment }))}
  groups={[{ id: "smb", label: "Small teams", noun: "small teams" }, { id: "ent", label: "Enterprise", noun: "enterprise teams" }]}
  onOpen={(voice) => track("testimonial_open", voice.id)}
/>
